**Step 2 — Turn Wi-Fi Calling OFF**
- Go to **Settings → Wi-Fi Calling** and toggle it **OFF**.

Wi-Fi Calling can interfere with MMS in some carrier configurations, so it's worth switching off while we sort this out.

**Step 3 — Reboot your device**
- Restart the phone completely.

This step is essential — **APN changes don't take effect until the device restarts.** Turning Wi-Fi Calling off in the same reboot saves you a second restart.
